claims.statement: Approximately 214 support agents were unable to access customer records due to stale authorization cache, with 31% of requests failing; mitigation restored access within 3 minutes
claims.corroboration: 214 affected users confirmed by support_report (m7_e11, tier 2). 31% failure rate before mitigation confirmed by helpdesk alert (m7_e02, tier 1). Mitigation outcome (m7_r_evict, tier 1) shows restoration to 1% within 3 minutes, validating the root cause identification.
claims.limitation: Impact reported via proxy count (support team reports), not total affected user census; 31% reflects request-level failure rate during the incident window.

next_action.rationale: Root cause has been established with discriminating evidence (m7_r_traces: directory holds v42, app cached v41). Mitigation (evict_entitlement_entries) was approved by human gate and executed successfully (m7_r_evict: 31% → 1% failures in 3 minutes). No open contradictions. All material claims have sources and dispositions. The incident is resolved and fully explained.
